original_card.question: Can one precisely specified helper-mixing word satisfy a replacement for the inherited H2/K interface?
methods: Derive a replacement interface lemma and price its implementation.
Seek an exact dirty-input or chronological-cut counterexample to the proposed replacement.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A full boundary contract and paid profile; unchanged scalar counts alone are insufficient.

first_step.inspect: Compare the two false H2/K flags with the unchanged paid profile in its README.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Write one replacement H2/K implication for a single helper-star operation, then try to falsify it on dirty inputs.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A legitimate replacement could admit a cheaper bit circuit; scalar savings alone do not alter the selected moment.
allowed_variations: Choose one helper-star or quartet instance; narrow to one boundary implication.
scope_change_triggers: Changing only source count or scalar addition count without an interface argument.

actual_scope: Answer PR1805 open question 1 by exhibiting and fully invoicing one ADD-greedy H2-sem matching (shuffle seed 7) that strictly dominates the published seed-42 matching on ADD count, F and B, with unchanged paid profile and dirty boundary.
scope_change_reason: PR1782/PR1805 already admit and price the seed-42 wraps under H2-sem. The card's acceptance gate (full boundary and paid profile) is applied to a new matching that improves the published (ADD,F) invoice; this is the stated next experiment of PR1805 rather than a new interface lemma.
bottleneck_link: A lower-F H2-sem-legal D wrap improves precision headroom on the nonbinding bit side without changing the paid recursive profile or selected moment.
stop_rule: Stop once one matching that strictly dominates seed-42 on ADD and F is fully invoiced with dirty controls, or after a bounded seed screen finds no such point.
evidence: PASS_H2SEM_MATCHING_F_INVOICE: seed-7 matching 208 pairs saves 6245 ADDs (24305->18060) with F=73805 vs seed-42 6231/75381; deltas -14 ADDs and -1576 F; profile mass 5129; 661 columns; 7 controls; seed screen 0..255 recorded in SWEEP.json.
author: Wentao Li
ai_assistance: Substantial AI assistance for matching screen, invoice verifier, and package documentation

open_questions.question: Is there a non-greedy disjoint matching with saving >= 6245 and F < 73805?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The seed screen only varies ADD-greedy tie-breaks; a genuine joint optimum could improve further.
open_questions.first_step: Local search from the seed-7 matching with single pair swaps scored by exact F.
open_questions.blocked_by: No cheaper exact point is known.

open_questions.question: Can a joint (ADD, F) objective on the PR1062 star word recover a net saving?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Open PR2033 showed the fixed pair costs +3 to +9 on the star word; a different matching might still help.
open_questions.first_step: Port this invoice method to the 11500-ADD star D.
open_questions.blocked_by: Star composition overhead on every candidate matching.
